name: GLP-1 (S)
subtitle: Weekly GLP-1 agonist
summary: The mainstream weekly injectable, with deep RCT coverage for weight and glycemic control.
caveat: Nausea and GI effects are common, which is why every schedule titrates slowly; weight tends to return after stopping.
